title: orobanche cicerbitae
intro: Orobanche cicerbitae, commonly known as broomrape, is a parasitic flowering plant that grows on the roots of the Asteraceae family, specifically on Cicerbita or Echinops species. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Orobanche cicerbitae include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and exhibit antioxidant and hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
